from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    candidates = [c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid)]
    divider = min(candidates, key=lambda c: sum(v == grid[0][c] for row in grid for v in row))
    left = [row[:divider] for row in grid]
    right = [row[divider + 1:] for row in grid]
    left_bg = Counter(v for row in left for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    right_bg = Counter(v for row in right for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if left[r][c] == left_bg and right[r][c] != right_bg else left_bg
             for c in range(len(left[0]))] for r in range(h)]

program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The panels are separated by a uniform center row or column.
    if h % 2 == 1 and all(v == grid[h//2][0] for v in grid[h//2]):
        n = h // 2
        a, b = grid[:n], grid[n+1:]
    elif w % 2 == 1 and all(row[w//2] == grid[0][w//2] for row in grid):
        n = w // 2
        a = [row[:n] for row in grid]
        b = [row[n+1:] for row in grid]
    else:
        raise ValueError("no centered uniform separator")
    common = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
    if not common:
        raise ValueError("panels have no common color")
    counts = Counter(v for row in a for v in row) + Counter(v for row in b for v in row)
    bg = max(common, key=lambda v: counts[v])
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else bg for c in range(len(a[0]))]
            for r in range(len(a))]
'''

    # The panels are separated by a uniform center row or column.
    if h % 2 == 1 and all(v == grid[h//2][0] for v in grid[h//2]):
        n = h // 2
        a, b = grid[:n], grid[n+1:]
    elif w % 2 == 1 and all(row[w//2] == grid[0][w//2] for row in grid):
        n = w // 2
        a = [row[:n] for row in grid]
        b = [row[n+1:] for row in grid]
    else:
        raise ValueError("no centered uniform separator")
    common = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
    if not common:
        raise ValueError("panels have no common color")
    counts = Counter(v for row in a for v in row) + Counter(v for row in b for v in row)
    bg = max(common, key=lambda v: counts[v])
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else bg for c in range(len(a[0]))]
